description: Central Province Provincial Council - Appoint Members to the Passanger Transport Service Authority of the Central Province
categorisation: This gazette exclusively contains government personnel appointments (Mr. H. M. P. Punchi Banda and others) to the Board of Directors of the Passenger Transport Service Authority. It names specific individuals and their new titles/positions but provides NO detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
